name: Twilightshollow
description:
Twilight's Hollow is a small SMP built on community values. We started as a small friend group tired of power abuse and we're looking for more people who share the same ideals as we do. Major decisions go to a community vote. The server is mostly vanilla but half of the map is custom terrain for a twist rarely seen on public servers.

The minimum age to join this community is 16 y/o.

Our promise:

We strive to provide an inclusive space in which everyone feels safe, can relax, and especially is heard.

Major decisions are always made democratically, far too many servers treat their players like a statistic.

We're all here for the same reason after all. To have fun. To meet people.

Our features:

Gameplay (entities and redstone) as close to vanilla as possible

No P2W whatsoever (no donations, playtime based ranks)

Custom terrain (tectonic and WWOO) and vanilla terrain

Bedrock support via Geyser

Live chat translation

No resets

Major Plugins:

Graves, simple voicechat, custom disks, pl3xmap, shopkeepers, Protection Stones, DH server side support.

Links:

https://map.twilightshollow.org/ (pl3xmap)

https://twilightshollow.org/ (website, mostly utilities)

https://discord.gg/AmArDSBfFK (discord)

twilightshollow.org (IP for java and bedrock)[/center]

PS. This server was founded in mid-April 2026.
